## Verdict

**Estuary** costs least for a team of 60, at **$660 per month**. All three vendors' minimums (50, 5, 20) fall below the team size, so every vendor bills exactly 60 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly. Estuary's $11 rate is the lowest on the list.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $17 | 50 |
| Lumen Path | $24 | 5 |
| Estuary | $11 | 20 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 60 (team size) or the vendor minimum. No minimum binds at this headcount.

- **Gable:** minimum 50 < 60, so 60 seats paid. 60 × $17 = **$1,020 per month**.
- **Lumen Path:** minimum 5 < 60, so 60 seats paid. 60 × $24 = **$1,440 per month**.
- **Estuary:** minimum 20 < 60, so 60 seats paid. 60 × $11 = **$660 per month**.

Estuary is $360 per month cheaper than Gable and $780 per month cheaper than Lumen Path — $4,320 and $9,360 per year. Spread between cheapest and dearest is $780 per month, with Estuary at 54% of Gable's cost and 46% of Lumen Path's.

## Risks

**Minimums bite if headcount falls.** Gable's 50-seat floor holds its bill at $850 even for a much smaller team; Estuary's 20-seat floor means $220. A team shrinking below 50 would see Gable's effective per-person rate climb sharply, while Estuary stays at list down to 20 people.

**Growth changes nothing in order.** All three scale linearly above 60 seats, so Estuary remains cheapest at any larger size on list price, and the absolute gap widens with each added seat.

**No volume discounting is documented.** At 60 seats, vendors often quote below list. These figures assume list pricing holds, which may overstate the real gap — particularly for Lumen Path, where there is most room to discount.

**Price only.** The list carries no feature, support, security or usage-limit data. The cheapest seat may not be a comparable product. Monthly billing is assumed as stated; annual terms and switching costs are unlisted.
